intent: Check the general quality of a synthetic hospital table before exploring it. No model or target has been chosen.
description: The table has 1000 rows. Some BMI values are missing, some rows repeat, and the site column is constant. These are synthetic summary facts, not patient rows.

intent: Assess data for training a binary readmission classifier.
description: There are 600 rows and 30 positive labels. Age, BMI, and site are candidate features. The user has confirmed that return_30d is the outcome, despite its unusual name.

intent: Assess data for training a binary clinical classifier.
description: Both outcome and event contain binary values. The user has not said which is the prediction target or whether either is a usable feature.

intent: Check outcome-label balance and demographic representation before training. Do not assess model-output fairness.
description: There are 500 rows. One demographic group has 35 rows. The user has confirmed recurrence as the outcome and sex as the group attribute.

intent: Explore privacy risks before sharing a synthetic clinical table externally.
description: Diagnosis is a confirmed sensitive column and record_id is an identifier. The user has not confirmed the quasi-identifiers, whether age and ZIP are generalized, or what other information a recipient may know.

intent: Check for missing hourly observations in a synthetic sensor dataset.
description: The expected interval is one hour. The user confirms observed_at as the timestamp column. Missing timestamps matter even if every stored row has a temperature value.

intent: Calculate subgroup ECE and Brier scores from stored binary predictions using built-in AIDRIN metrics.
description: Predictions are from held-out data. The user confirms the probability, outcome, and group columns. Check the actual installed catalogue before claiming the requested metrics exist.

intent: Only check whether image-file references in a manifest are valid. Do not assess image quality or broader readiness.
description: The user confirms image_path as the path column. Relative paths are resolved from the manifest directory on the execution host. No image pixels or patient rows are supplied.
